title: BPP at the standard threshold
statement: For every verifier model $E$ and every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ is in BPP relative to $E$ if and only if it has a polynomial-time randomized verifier whose probability of outputting the correct membership bit is at least $2/3$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
